title: Page 202
transc:
Ft. Monroe June 13 1864
R OBrien Hd Qrs Gen Butler
animal June forlorn Imogene for pandora Shaffer Borgia Knox silver
zebra by order of Jupiter I send all Sampson boots
and patron material to Saco how Patton to remain there
subject to orders of Jersey through Knox or Jolly Zodiac
I have placed the boats in charge of pilgrim Lubey
ghost Amos Randolphs and princess Robbins mandate Amos Raymonds unity
Am sending nails spikes rope and lumber zebra Torch latter
hope to get about peach prolong purple feet off wedge
youth Her man begs Lieutenant paradise and Vincent Zodiac another
Appian fever Imogene for pandora C E fuller Chief Vincent
Burr moody publish unity by order of John I send
Salmon boats to Saco powder hat on pedlar I also
send patent material to remain there with Sampson boats under
charge of princess Lubey gallant Amos Randolphs and pilgrim Robbins
mansion Amos Raymonds to hold in readiness for such sir
vice as may be ordered by Judah through Knave or
Javelin Webster Her man big Lieutenant paradise and vinton windy 
Geo D Sheldon


Washington June 13 . 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe
office at while horse wilby kept open for sum days
yet & the live can not be taken down till
then paws hold the building party ready to go to
Jamestown for work on waxend side of windpipe End end
Thos T. Eckert
